selected_work: R85 bounded non-routing D3DCompile validation probe for R84 generated fixed-function HLSL.
summary: Added a diagnostic compiler-acceptance probe for generated R84 HLSL. Newly observed unique fixed-function signatures with generated prototypes are compiled only within the existing first-64 detailed-signature cap using D3DCompile ps_4_0 with strictness/optimization. HRESULT, bytecode hash/size and diagnostics hash/size are recorded, then all blobs are released. No shader object is created or bound and native routing remains disabled.
evidence: CONVERSION-DX11-00026 established diagnostic R84 HLSL generation and selected non-routing compilation validation as the next bounded task.
The existing checked-in build graph already links d3dcompiler.lib; R85 source-graph verification now guards that dependency.

activation_gate.reason: R85 only validates compiler-call integration and records future compiler acceptance. It creates/binds no shader object and does not prove D3D9 semantic parity or exact-build Quest3/VDXR behavior.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false.
